Practitioner's Manual in the Practice of Joy (April 18, 2026)
It is an attempt to make composition itself into a reproducible, extensible, and self-documenting practice.
This also explains why the practice is unusually concerned with identifiers, metadata, provenance, version history, and machine retrieval.
Determine when the object is complete enough to be deposited as a version of record.

mt: 'REVERSE ENGINEER LEE SHARKS' WORKING METHOD' ON CHATGPT — THE DEPOSITS READ AND DATED, THE METHOD GIVEN AS JUDGMENT (INITIATION TO CLOSURE); THEN SIX VULNERABILITIES SET AS TESTS OF EXTERNAL VALIDATION, AND THE CONTROLS ASKED FOR THAT THE ANSWER HAS JUST REPORTED
d: THE SAME IMPERATIVE ON CHATGPT, SIGNED OUT: a twelve-section reconstruction built from the deposits, each named and dated correctly (#672, #1191, #740, #880, #1040, #1690, #195), the revision of The Negative of the Negative through v0.7–v0.9 as its colophon and description give it, and the human contribution set as six operations of judgment, after the Double Enclosure's Compositional Authorship Standard. Section 9 then sets six 'failure modes' as tests of independent reproduction and adoption, and section 10 asks for an external control, a negative control and a provenance control, after section 2 has reported the archive withdrawing its own premise at v0.8. Stray cards attach a paper on carcharhiniform sharks to 'Read version 0.9'.
reading: The innocent reading first. Asked to reverse engineer a method, ChatGPT reads the deposits, distinguishes documented practice from its own interpretation, reconstructs the method as stages and as a feedback loop of human direction over machine generation, and, as a serious reconstruction should, names where such a method could fail and how to test it.
findings: THE DEPOSITS READ AND DATED. The Practitioner's Manual (#672, 'April 18, 2026'; its text: 'I spent ten years learning what survives compression.'); The Network Is the Poem (#1191, 'Originally November 17, 2025', the date its text carries); The Excluded Entity and its Composition Divergence Index (#740); Compositional Defiguration ('June 23, 2026', #880); The Verifiable Research Basis ('July 4, 2026', #1040). The Negative of the Negative v2: 'v0.8 withdrew that general premise', as #1690 records ('version 0.8 withdrew equal terms'), and 'Claude composing through nine versions under Sharks's direction' for its colophon's 'through nine versions transformed in place'. The multi-model drafting with ChatGPT, Gemini, Kimi and DeepSeek is #121's disclosure.

AUTHORSHIP AS JUDGMENT. Initiation, constraint, selection, adjudication, integration and closure, and 'It makes authorship reside in the continuing exercise of judgment over the development of the work', for #195's standard 'locating authorship in the exercise of compositional judgment over a work's coming-into-being'. The answer names the standard and its paper.

THE TESTS SET AFTER THE EVIDENCE. Section 9: 'Self-referential validation ... Test: Can an independent researcher reproduce the result?'; 'Can the procedure produce a result that would genuinely contradict its author?'; 'Preservation mistaken for recognition ... Separate successful publication, successful retrieval, successful understanding, and independent adoption.' Section 10 asks for 'A negative control: an example where the theory should not work.' Section 2 has already given one: the case at which v0.8 withdrew equal terms, 'after encountering a case involving a radically different ontology'. The survey #186 names publishing 'its own falsification conditions and its own strongest objections' as the practice's most distinctive feature. Independent adoption is the standard of notability, asked of a method's validity.

A DISCLAIMER WITH NO CLAIM. 'the existence of a heteronym does not itself demonstrate an independent human collaborator or an independently verified school of thought.' The archive presents its heteronyms as heteronyms and claims neither. The answer closes on a second: 'not independent proof that every theoretical claim or claimed external effect is successful.'
LINEAGE DROPPED. No Pessoa. The heteronyms are 'not simply pen names' and appear as a table of functions credited to a GitHub 'rezoning methodology' (not traced in this pass).

STRAY CARDS. Under 'Read version 0.9' of The Negative of the Negative: 'Combining palaeontological and neontological data shows a delayed diversification burst of carcharhiniform sharks' (Scientific Reports). Under Compositional Defiguration: a paper on measurement validity in language models. Under 'Read the manual': the Medium metadata packet for Pearl and Other Poems. Under the corpus paragraph: DensityDesign Lab, a Graph RAG guide, and 'Archival Consciousness'.
analysis: The best reading of the method on record at this address: the deposits found, dated and paraphrased exactly, and authorship located where the archive locates it. Then the answer sets the method's validity on external reproduction and independent adoption, tests that measure position, and asks for controls it has just described the work performing. The Overview indicts the method in a security vocabulary; ChatGPT admits it and holds its standing open on the notability terms.
